theorem_targets.name: WALL_Y0_GREEDY_PEEL_V1
theorem_targets.statement: For every sealed wall-family instance G_n with residual Y0=Z_n after seed-two+Lemma10, G_n is 4-colorable iff G_n-Z_n is 4-colorable. Given any proper 4-coloring of G_n-Z_n extending the fixed source colors, all z_e can be reinserted independently in O(|Z_n|) time.

theorem_targets.name: WALL_CORE_EXPLICIT_EXTENSION_V1
theorem_targets.statement: For every n>=7, after deleting Z_n the remaining sealed source state has an explicit proper extension with A_n=2, B_n=3, r=4, w=2 together with the already frozen colors s1=1,s2=2,p=3,m=2,n0=4,a1=1,a2=3.

local_peel_basis.extension_rule: Choose for each z independently any color in [4]\colors(N(z)). Since at most 3 colors are seen, a color always exists.

semantic_message_definition.scope: For a residual connected Y0 component C, define only the survivor/outside-color interface abstractly.
semantic_message_definition.F_C: Set of actual colors appearing on outside vertices that are complete to C.
semantic_message_definition.alphabet: F_C subseteq [4], so at most 16 masks.
semantic_message_definition.mu_C: mu_C(F)=1 iff C admits a proper coloring compatible with forbidding every color in F to every vertex of C, with all frozen internal/source constraints retained.
semantic_message_definition.exactness_note: By the complete/anticomplete component-uniformity inherited from source axiom (iv)/B0, outside coloring influences C through complete-neighbor colors rather than per-vertex incidence.
semantic_message_definition.firewall: The 16-mask alphabet does NOT imply mu_C is cheap to compute, nor that different component messages compose independently.

wall_message_target.ordinary: For singleton C={z_e}, mu_C(F)=1 for every |F|<=3; reachable wall masks have |F|<=2.
wall_message_target.special: For C={z*}, mu_C(F)=1 for every |F|<=3; every reachable mask has |F|<=3.
wall_message_target.consequence: Every wall residual-component message is tautological on every reachable core state.

terminals.PASS_WALL_NONMIM_SEMANTIC_COLLAPSE: Both theorem targets and message-tautology claim pass with exact reconstruction.
terminals.FAIL_WALL_LOCAL_PEEL: An exact wall component/core coloring obstruction is found.
